description: This file defines the 'Borders' class within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace, representing a collection of border objects (top, bottom, left, right, diagonal up, diagonal down) used for document elements like paragraphs and tables. It includes methods for accessing, cloning, and serializing border properties, as well as managing internal nullable values.

classes.name: Borders
classes.description: Represents a collection of border objects, providing accessors for individual borders, methods for cloning, clearing, and serializing borders, and managing internal values.

classes.name: Borders.BordersValues
classes.description: Internal class encapsulating the nullable internal values for border properties, such as individual Border objects, style, width, color, visibility, and distances.

methods.name: HasBorder
methods.description: Checks whether a specific border exists for the given BorderType.

methods.name: GetBorder
methods.description: Retrieves the Border object corresponding to a specified BorderType, or null if it does not exist.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Borders object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the internal deep copy operation, cloning all individual border objects.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all border objects from the collection, marking them as null for serialization.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Borders object into DDL format, writing border properties and nested borders.

methods.name: GetMyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the border based on the Border object provided.
